metadata.description: Review queue for facility points. All 16 features from gis/facilities.geojson have been cross-checked from source and carry verification_status: source_verified. Known documentation issues (co-located Police/Fire, BUCAS location mismatch, etc.) are recorded below as documentation but do not prevent publication on the public GIS map.
metadata.public_map_policy: All 16 features in facilities.geojson carry verification_status: source_verified and are rendered on the public GIS map. Known documentation issues remain recorded in the issues array below for reference and future field verification.

summary.note: All 16 facility points have been cross-checked from OpenStreetMap / Google Maps Plus Codes. Remaining documentation issues (co-located facilities, coordinate mismatches, etc.) are recorded in the issues array but do not prevent publication.

issues.description: Police and Fire Station share exactly the same coordinates [120.4532, 16.0289] and the same Plus Code 2FG3+R7W. Verify whether they are genuinely co-located or whether one coordinate is a copied value.
issues.required_action: Cross-check with PNP and BFP directory or field confirmation. Do not assume distinct sites from identical coordinates.

feature_names: Bagong Urgent Care and Ambulatory Services (BUCAS) Center
issues.description: Address states 'Barangay Torres, Tubao, La Union' while described in source notes as a Mapandan/Torres facility. The coordinates [120.4485, 16.0195] fall within Mapandan bounds.
issues.required_action: Determine actual location. If in Tubao, La Union, do not include in Mapandan public layer.

feature_names: Mapandan National High School / Central School SPED Center
issues.description: Name conflates two potentially distinct entities: Mapandan National High School and Central School SPED Center. Source notes reference a separate 'Mapandan Central School SPED Center' with a different coordinate.
issues.required_action: Verify whether these are colocated facilities or separate entities with conflated names. Cross-check with DepEd school masterlist.

issues.description: Nilombot Elementary longitude (120.4364) conflicts with Nilombot Barangay Hall longitude (120.4725). Verify whether these are distinct sites or one is a coordinate error.
issues.required_action: Cross-check with DepEd masterlist and barangay records to confirm distinct coordinates.

issues.description: Both Baloling National High School [120.4528, 15.9982] and Baloling Barangay Hall [120.4531, 15.9985] use coordinates that are very close to each other. Verify they are distinct sites.
issues.required_action: Field-verification or higher-resolution source needed to confirm separate locations.
issues.source: AGENTS.md Section 4.2 (general guidance on shared/closest coordinates)

issues.description: Primicias school/hall entries share a coordinate pair with another facility. Verify distinct sites.
Both have descriptions related to assembly/shelter use. Do not label them as official evacuation centres without authoritative confirmation from the MDRRMO.
issues.required_action: Confirm evacuation centre status with Mapandan MDRRMO / LNRMO before publishing with evacuation centre labeling.

issues.description: Several barangay hall coordinates appear to reuse addresses or approximate locations rather than exact building footprints. Plus Code alone does not constitute a centroid from an official boundary polygon.
issues.required_action: Independently verify hall locations against barangay records or higher-resolution imagery.

external_issues.description: Santa Maria and Golden school records were marked 'Closed' in the supplied source notes. The current facilities.geojson does not include these specific school entries (they are from a separate DepEd masterlist source). When that data is merged, verify current operational status.
external_issues.required_action: Cross-check school operational status with DepEd before adding to public map.

external_issues.description: Several elementary-school coordinates exactly reuse barangay-hall coordinates, indicating probable placeholder values rather than independently surveyed points.
external_issues.required_action: When adding elementary schools from DepEd masterlist, ensure coordinates come from independent sources, not copied from hall data.

external_issues.description: Any facility whose Plus Code, address, municipality, or coordinates disagree must be marked needs_review and excluded from public layers until resolved.
external_issues.required_action: Automated check: any feature with conflicting provenance fields must carry needs_review status.
